scripts.build:harness: node build/ensure-core-wasm.mjs && tsc -b && VITE_OM_DEV_HARNESS=1 OM_BUNDLE_DEV=1 vite build --outDir dist-harness --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:core-e2e: node build/ensure-core-wasm.mjs && tsc -b && VITE_OM_E2E_CORE=1 OM_BUNDLE_DEV=1 vite build --outDir dist-core-e2e --emptyOutDir
